legal_standard: FACT = government news release or official project page. REPORTING = secondary/vendor. DISCLOSURE_GAP = search performed, row not found.

findings.claim: On 30 May 2022, Government of Canada announced award of a contract of approximately $800 million to Bell Textron Canada Limited (Mirabel, QC) to extend life of 85 CH-146 Griffon helicopters at least to the mid-2030s.
extra: OEM IP sole-source framing: BTCL holds IP; only firm authorized to assess/define design changes
Contract structure: Bell modifies 9 aircraft then manages competitive subcontract for remaining 76
Team Griffon includes CMC Electronics and Pratt & Whitney Canada
First upgraded helicopter expected 2024; remainder by 2028 (per 2022 release)

findings.claim: Open Government search under BOTH vendor strings fails to surface ~$800M GLLE: (a) BELL HELICOPTER TEXTRON CANADA — 22 rows mostly DFO; (b) Bell Textron Canada Limited — 463 rows, only 2 National Defence, facet only 2 contracts >$5M — no matching GLLE instrument visible 2026-07-11.
findings.implication: PSPC announced award publicly; proactive disclosure does not present a matching DND ~$800M row under award legal name. ATIP E required. See lap3 gap file.

findings.claim: ISED Industrial and Technological Benefits contractor-progress page (search index / public report class) lists Bell Helicopter Textron Canada / Griffon Limited Life Extension with obligation class ~$693,677,885 (CAD) — consistent with ITB on ~$800M award class.
findings.note: Table rows appear dynamically loaded; full row freeze needs browser capture or CSV export. Page modified class 2026-05-01. Do not treat snippet as audited paid-to-date.
findings.residual: Export ITB CSV / screenshot full GLLE row: award date, completed, in progress, to be identified

findings.claim: DND project page still lists Phase 3 Definition and 2022/2024/2027 schedule with page-details 2020-12-02; does not absorb 2022 award announcement language or 2026 pause.
